note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `gradedAt` is a wall-clock ISO timestamp stamped by the grader; `bin/test-personas` strips volatile timestamp-shaped keys before comparing, so it is not present in `expected`.

personas.name: normal-annual-health-check-complete
personas.description: A normal routine annual-health-check panel: every measured analyte is within its reference range, eGFR is CKD G1, no abnormal or critical flags, all five mandatory report sections present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

state.findingsNarrative: All measured analytes are within the laboratory reference range.
state.comparisonWithPrevious: No previous results available for comparison; this is a baseline panel.
state.impression: Normal full blood count, renal, liver, and metabolic panel.

expected.recommendedAction: No specific follow-up required; manage per usual care.

firedRules.description: No abnormal results on an adequate specimen; classified as normal.
No abnormal result; abnormality severity graded none.
No escalation rule fired; routine follow-up only.

personas.name: abnormal-ckd-progression-moderate-complete
personas.description: Routine CKD monitoring bloods showing further renal decline: eGFR has fallen to 25 mL/min/1.73m2 (CKD G4), abnormalResultsPresent is flagged, report complete — expect abnormal classification + moderate severity + 100% completeness + recommended follow-up + repeat-test, with an abnormal-action flag and a separate urgent-referral flag from eGFR < 30 (two independently-triggered flags from the same low eGFR value).

state.clinicalHistory: Known CKD stage 3b, routine monitoring bloods.
state.findingsNarrative: Renal function has declined further since the previous panel, with eGFR now in the CKD G4 range.
state.comparisonWithPrevious: eGFR has fallen from 34 to 25 mL/min/1.73m2 over the past 6 months.
state.impression: Worsening chronic kidney disease, now CKD stage 4.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Refer to the renal team; repeat U&E in 4 weeks.

expected.recommendedAction: Recommend repeat testing or specialist referral as clinically indicated.

firedRules.description: One or more abnormal results are present; classified as abnormal.
One or more abnormal results are present; abnormality severity graded moderate.

flags.description: An abnormal result requiring timely action is present.
flags.suggestedAction: Ensure the requester is alerted and a clear action plan is documented.

flags.description: eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m² indicates advanced renal impairment.
flags.suggestedAction: Consider urgent referral to the renal team.

personas.name: critical-severe-hyperkalaemia-uncommunicated-incomplete
personas.description: Severe hyperkalaemia (potassium 7.2 mmol/L) phoned through from the on-call lab: a critical (panic) value auto-escalates classification to critical and follow-up to critical-alert regardless of the other axes; the result has not yet been recorded as communicated and no critical-value detail was recorded, each independently raising its own flag, alongside a missing impression and several other report sections left blank — expect critical classification + major severity + 40% completeness + critical-alert follow-up + urgent-review.

state.findingsNarrative: Severe hyperkalaemia on a haemolysis-free sample; ECG changes not yet assessed.
state.clinicianNotes: Phoned through from the on-call lab; ward contacted for urgent ECG and treatment.

expected.recommendedAction: Communicate the critical result directly to the requester now and document the conversation.

firedRules.description: A critical (panic) value is present; classified as critical.
Critical (panic) value present; abnormality severity graded major.
